method: Direct indexed-triangle GLB and Meshopt decoding; no author geometry rebuild. Convex sections describe external bulk, not interior completeness.

surfaceProbes.label: garden-wide-window
surfaceProbes.selection_note: Independent middle-bay pane point at an alternate height on the folded garden facade.

surfaceProbes.label: garden-wall-positive-control
surfaceProbes.selection_note: Masonry between two broad windows; solid control adjacent to the previous hole probe.

surfaceProbes.label: central-narrow-window
surfaceProbes.selection_note: Narrow central tower column, away from mullion and continuous pale fin.

surfaceProbes.label: central-continuous-fin-positive-control
surfaceProbes.selection_note: A real pale fin between narrow columns; offset avoids the full-only fine rib.

surfaceProbes.label: outer-wing-narrow-window
surfaceProbes.selection_note: Outer pale-accent wing window instead of repeating the central garden facade test.

surfaceProbes.label: rear-estimated-window
surfaceProbes.selection_note: Tests actual closure/opening geometry only; rear appearance is explicitly unverified by the photographs.

surfaceProbes.label: crown-recessed-brick-back
surfaceProbes.selection_note: The upper crown has deep blind grooves with brick backing, not unproven through-holes.

surfaceProbes.label: crown-solid-rib-positive-control
surfaceProbes.selection_note: Pale rib between adjacent deep grooves.

surfaceProbes.label: crown-solid-head-positive-control
surfaceProbes.selection_note: Above the groove opening, the crown head must remain solid.

surfaceProbes.selection_note: Independently selected point on a different actual exposed terrace: a single full-height roof would fail this stepped-height test.
